Telangana Man Pays ₹1.1 Lakh for Bike Using Only ₹10 Coins

A man in Telangana purchased a motorcycle for ₹1.1 lakh by paying the entire amount in ₹10 coins. The transaction took place in Nalgonda. Showroom workers spent time counting the coins. The unique purchase drew a crowd and became a sensation.
